tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open main draw begins Sunday Aug 30 — Alcaraz opens title defense vs Safiullin; Venus Williams faces Kenin; Fan Week wraps today • [SQUASH] Velavan Senthilkumar wins maiden PSA title at Budapest Open, beating Farkas 11-4, 11-2, 11-3; World Squash Masters opening ceremony tonight in Perth • [BADMINTON] Lee Zii Jia eyes Vietnam Open reset after skipping Asian Games — Malaysia star looks to rebuild form post-BWF Worlds • [PICKLEBALL] MLP Finals Day 2 in Central Park — St. Louis Shock sweep Dallas into Sunday final; NJ 5s lead Brooklyn 1-0, Game 2 at 10 a.m. ET • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 1 Day 2 — men's groups continue in Lille, women's in Budaörs; Stage 2 spots decided Sunday

newsItems.title: US Open Ready for First Round
newsItems.excerpt: Fan Week ends Aug 29 as the 2026 US Open main draw opens Sunday — Carlos Alcaraz begins his title defense against Roman Safiullin and Venus Williams faces Sofia Kenin in a wild-card clash at Flushing Meadows.

newsItems.title: Shock Punch MLP Finals Ticket
newsItems.excerpt: St. Louis swept Dallas 2-0 on Friday to reach the DoorDash MLP Finals at Wollman Rink, while New Jersey leads Brooklyn 1-0 ahead of Saturday's semifinal Game 2 at 10 a.m. ET.

newsItems.title: Zii Jia Targets Vietnam Open
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Lee Zii Jia is using the September Vietnam Open to regroup after early exits and skipping the Asian Games, with a month of training behind his bid for a first title since 2024.

newsItems.title: ETTU Champions League Heats Up
newsItems.excerpt: Stage 1 rolls into Day 2 with 16 men's clubs battling in Lille and eight women's sides in Budaörs — top finishers in each group clinch berths in the next Champions League round by Sunday.
